review.implemented_subclaim: Prepare separately bound agent, registry, base-image and package storage/processing sovereignty review against explicit organizational requirements.
evidence_requirements: Bind approved country/region/geography and storage-versus-processing requirements to scope/time and the actual agent, package registry, base-image, build-context, upstream origin, redirect, cache/log/artifact/backup and replication population. Keep approvals blank; geography is not an exact region or a legal sovereignty determination. Use redacted references, never raw source/pipeline payloads, personal identities, credentials, tokens or unnecessary account/location inventories.

Reconcile current service boundaries independently: Azure Geo commitments have service/preview exceptions; Azure DevOps Services uses geography with US macOS/token and Brazil DR/capacity fallback; GitHub.com defaults US, while GHE.com offers EU including EFTA Norway/Switzerland, Australia, US and Japan with telemetry/support/billing/Copilot/optional secret-check exceptions. ACR syncs all configured replicas and global routing can select another replica; regional layer redirects remain within the serving replica, not necessarily every required boundary. Premium dedicated task pools are Linux-only preview in published regions and still consume external dependencies and changing precached images.

Reviewer decision: do attributable complete agent/registry/base-image/dependency storage AND execution/processing evidence satisfy the explicitly approved boundary, including documented exceptions? Leave outcome, scope-bound approval attribution, rationale and expiry blank until supplied; URL, runner label, registry/resource location or one image digest alone proves no sovereignty outcome.
review.limitations: No estate/region/account/registry/agent lookup, upload, build task, package publication or fabricated residency/legal approval. Published availability is not actual location or eligibility. Unknown external services, partial copies, denied provenance and stale requirements remain explicit manual gaps.
